ambiguous_aliases.recommendation: One optional loom icon, not two knowledge nodes; neither id exists in live knowledge.ron.

chapters.illustration_brief: An open-front hide-and-branch shelter, warm hearth, bundled firewood, small family under plain fur wraps; frost and snow outside. No metal or cloth dye.
Several humble huts and a roofed dry store, baskets of food, one adult teaching a younger person to shape stone. No metal.
Unglazed pottery beside a hearth while two newcomers arrive carrying plain bundles; settlement welcomes them.
A small first grain field beside an undyed cloth loom, harvest sheaf in foreground. Stone tools only.
A pair of goats and a kid inside a cord-lashed wooden pen, shepherd with undyed plain wrap; first livestock chapter.
Clay copper smelter glowing above charcoal, newly cast reddish copper ingot on stone, green copper ore in foreground. No iron.
Mud-brick village with casting bench, bronze axe, wooden wheel and grain store; warm bronze focal highlight, no iron.
Bloomery and smithy with dark iron tool beside a newly paved stone road, settlement beginning to connect.
Modest iron-age town with market stalls, stone gate, storehouse and record tablet; no classical monumental marble city.
Established stone-age village: timber houses, grain plots, pottery, undyed cloth and goat pen. No metals. Keep as a separate legacy C1 chapter asset.

reconciliation_notes: Bible headings (~190 total; bronze 55; iron 50) are targets, not exhaustive enumerations. Concrete union = 167 IDs: current 82 + planned bronze 48 + planned iron 37. Optional loom placeholder adds one candidate illustration, not two nodes.
Bible §4.2 basket_loom→loom is an unnamed alias/existing-building placeholder; neither id is a current knowledge node. Weaving is the existing knowledge. Do not invent a runtime binding.
Bible §4.3 flax_retting says existing, but it is absent from current knowledge.ron; retain as planned bronze icon.

Current era counts are 32 paleolithic and 50 neolithic, not bible headline 38 and 45. Current data has timber_wall, stone_walling, clay_digging, clay_prep, pot_forming, spinning in neolithic and also rye (climate-table crop). Keep source eras recorded.

Art brief forbids dyed cloth before bronze although bible and current data put dyeing in neolithic. Depict raw pigments/dye preparation with no dyed garment for this icon, or hold the colored-cloth variant for bronze; do not silently change runtime era.
